purpose: Current author-specified manuscript implementation; not recovered historical checkpoints or independently reproduced results

source_policy.retained_contract: Current manuscript Appendix B.7, reference/controller_config.json: architecture, AdamW, initialization, update order, parameter counts and Gumbel index
author_specified_settings: hidden Kaiming-uniform ReLU; output Xavier-uniform; zero biases
prospective_reimplementation_choices: prompt cap scope, overflow and history provenance
public stream bindings and artifact schema
source_policy.result_policy: Parameter totals are structure-derived. Accuracy and timing require new run IDs and fresh evaluation; matching this specification does not recover historical runs.

reference_controller.initialization: hidden Kaiming-uniform ReLU; output Xavier-uniform; zero biases
update_order: one actor optimizer step with critics frozen
one Polyak update of both targets
reference_controller.target_initialization: exact frozen copy of online critics
reference_controller.actor_gradients: continuous score-function critic gradient and reparameterized entropy; categorical straight-through Gumbel; see trainer.py and docs/NAACL_RUNTIME.md
reference_controller.evaluation: tanh(mean) affine mapped to budget range; smallest categorical argmax + 1

training.buffer: one immutable task/family behavior buffer shared across methods; no on-policy additions
training.independent: Separate 170-wide role-specific actors and critics; absent opposite heads; separate TMS counterparts during fitting; combine learned heads only after selection, without joint fine-tuning.
training.checkpoint_selection: maximum eligible discounted return, then lower eligible budget, lower eligible candidate count, earlier update
training.resume: weights, targets, optimizer states, sampler state, RNG states and iteration counter required; otherwise start a new run
training.tms_binding: Required development-derived task/family schedule artifact, complete eligible population stable slot IDs, public 256-bit hash seed, development means and source hashes. No fixed 3/5 fallback.

prompt.cap_scope: all final model-input token IDs including wrapper, visual placeholders, retrieval, history, current instruction and generation prefix
prompt.action_history_source: preceding reference-record thoughts only; no current/future target action or generated thought
prompt.scoring_text: G: current thought; A: request followed by retained thoughts, joined by newline, without whitespace normalization
overflow_order: remove lowest-scored retrieval entry, last entry on a tie
prompt.render_contract: Tokenize the complete final model prompt after each removal; store exact token IDs, UTF-8 scoring span and its embedding-token IDs.
